name: Ghostscript
summary: Current upstream Ghostscript PostScript/PDF CLI compiled for browser WebAssembly with an isolated-worker MEMFS runtime.

profiles.label: Browser Full
features: BMP / JPEG / PNG / PS / TIFF output-driver groups

profiles.output: Generic Ghostscript gs CLI for local PostScript/PDF rendering and conversion
profiles.size: Loaded from the published release manifest

integration.summary: Self-host the wrapper plus gs-core.js/gs-core.wasm and run ordinary Ghostscript CLI arguments against files in MEMFS.
integration.example:
<script src="/vendor/ghostscript/browser-ghostscript.js"></script>
<script type="module">
const gs = WasmZooGhostscript.loadHosted({ baseUrl: "/vendor/ghostscript/" });
try {
  const result = await gs.exec([
    "-dSAFER", "-dBATCH", "-dNOPAUSE",
    "-sDEVICE=png16m", "-r150",
    "-sOutputFile=/out/page.png", "/input.pdf"
  ], {
    files: [{ name: "/input.pdf", data: file }],
    dirs: ["/out"],
    outputs: ["/out/page.png"]
  });
  return result.files[0].data;
} finally {
  gs.dispose();
}
</script>
notes: The current browser-full profile is single-threaded and does not require SharedArrayBuffer.
Each command runs in a fresh Worker/MEMFS instance.
The published Ghostscript Wasm binary is AGPL-3.0-or-later; review licensing before redistribution.

comparison.name: Upstream native
comparison.note: Full native Ghostscript can integrate with operating-system print/display services and optional platform libraries.

comparison.name: WASM Zoo
comparison.note: Current Ghostscript gs CLI with browser-oriented file-output devices and native desktop integrations removed.

notes: Official Ghostscript 10.07.1 release source archive is pinned by SHA-256 in addition to the source branch commit.
The real Chromium smoke test renders a PDF to PNG and converts PostScript to PDF with pdfwrite.
Automatic upstream candidate substitution is intentionally disabled for Ghostscript until the watcher also captures and verifies the new official source-asset digest.
GhostPCL and GhostXPS remain outside this package even though they share the GhostPDL source tree.

referenceWasm.name: @okathira/ghostpdl-wasm
referenceWasm.note: Reference npm package 1.1.0 is built from Ghostscript/GhostPDL 10.06.0 and exposes FS/callMain.

capabilityMatrix.note: Core Ghostscript PostScript interpreter is retained.
Browser smoke test renders a real PDF fixture through png16m.
Browser smoke test converts PostScript to a new PDF.

capabilityMatrix.feature: PNG / JPEG / BMP / TIFF file output
capabilityMatrix.note: The selected output-driver groups target common file conversion workflows.
These are separate GhostPDL interpreters and are not part of the Ghostscript gs artifact.
Browser WebAssembly has no native print spooler integration; these configure paths are disabled.
Browser rendering is returned as output files rather than an OS display surface.
Input and output live in Emscripten MEMFS inside an isolated Worker.
The first Zoo profile stays single-threaded for simpler deployment.
